text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Here's to another great<n>day!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for giving me some time off!<n>I'm totally
refreshed, and I even got<n>to eat my favorite bento
box. Now I'm<n>all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You know what? You really need to<n>try Kyoto's
local inari bento too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's the best thing for when you need<n>an energy
boost! It's simple in taste,<n>but it never grows old!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Seeking the Pearl had a<n>fulfilling day
off and was able to<n>indulge in her favorite bento
box.
